title: What's New: The Danish Bookkeeping Act (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: SAF-T Module and Chart of Accounts Mapping

features.name: Mandatory Digital Vouchers
features.description: Global feature that enforces attachment of purchase and sales documents before posting. In Denmark, purchase documents must be attached before posting; sales documents are automatically created and attached by the system.
features.status_evidence_quote: all new plan features are part of 2023 release wave two but they will not all of them will be available in October they
caveats: Available in 2023 release wave 2, but not all features available in October
Will be ready for beginning of next calendar year

features.name: SAF-T Module
features.description: Created on top of audit file export app, contains SAF-T export, Danish public standard chart of account, and standard VAT chart of account. Allows mapping existing chart of accounts to standard chart of accounts and export in SAF-T and CSV formats.
features.status_evidence_quote: all new plan features are part of 2023 release wave two but they will not all of them will be available in October they
caveats: Public standard chart of account mapping is mandatory for compliance
Will be finished and ready for beginning of next year

features.name: NemHandle Registration Notification
features.description: System displays notification if company is not registered with NemHandle service. If CVR number is registered in NemHandle, Business Central verifies it and notification disappears. Registration is mandatory for invoicing.
features.status_evidence_quote: all new plan features are part of 2023 release wave two but they will not all of them will be available in October they
caveats: NemHandle registration is mandatory to use invoicing
Registration must be completed before proceeding with invoicing functionality

features.name: E-invoicing for Denmark
features.description: Based on e-documents core module with local format options OioPh and PEP3. Includes connectors to third party access points for document exchange with NemHandle. Requires VAT submission through Danish tax agency API.
features.status_evidence_quote: this app is still work in progress and it will be finished soon so it will be ready for the beginning of usage of
caveats: Will be ready for beginning of certification process
VAT API submission still in development

features.name: Digital Voucher Storage for Five Years
features.description: System must support storage of recorded bookkeeping transactions in digital vouchers for five years, immutable by user or administrator. Production companies cannot be deleted once registered. Microsoft must retain data for five years after fiscal year end per Danish law, then delete per GDPR.
features.status_evidence_quote: this solution will be automatically set up and this is still work in progress uh we are we are finishing the these procedures but
caveats: Automatically configured, no manual setup required
Microsoft retains data for five years minimum for authorities

features.name: Audit Trail for Transactions
features.description: Every transaction automatically creates audit trail with registration date, transaction number or ID, user ID of person who recorded it, and system changes. Entries cannot be deleted, backdated or changed - corrections require new entries.

features.name: Bank Reconciliation
features.description: Advanced bank reconciliation allowing import of electronic bank statements in various formats including CSV, with automatic reconciliation to bank transactions. Bank accounts linked to chart of account through posting groups.
